title: Jesus His Empire Shall Extend
description: Jesus His Empire Shall Extend in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Hosea Ballou wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 286 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus his em-pire shall ex-tend; Be-neath his gen-tle sway Kings of the earth shall hum-bly bend, And his com-mands o-bey.

lines: Kings of the earth shall humbly bend,
From sea to sea, from shore to shore,
We hear the noise of war no more, —
As clouds descend in gentle showers,
And call to life the fragrant flowers
So Jesus, by his heavenly grace,
And o'er the millions of our race
All that the reign of sin destroyed,
And, from the treasures of the Lord,

licence: Public domain: Hosea Ballou died in 1852.
credits: Words by Hosea Ballou (1771–1852), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
